description: A write-only cell seeded from a server-only constant (`let <tk:Tok=({ v: API_KEY })/>`, client code only writes it whole): accepted, and each whole write is checked — `@tk = { v: "" }` traps before it lands (n stays 0), then `{ v: "ok" }` lands (n = 1).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up")
rationale: §66.13.5: every write that touches the read set is checked on the candidate before it lands; 7a: a whole-value write judges the written value and does not read the field it overwrites.
